conventions: Paths are relative to the repo root. Line numbers come from the 2026-10-14 review, at commit 071efb8; earlier packages in this run may move them, so search for the code they point at.
Copy is shown in backticks as EN / ES / CA and is exact. Write apostrophes and quotes the way the catalogs already do (’, «», “”).

Every new or changed string goes in app_en.arb, app_es.arb and app_ca.arb, with ICU plurals for counts and the locale helpers for dates (App/docs/LOCALIZATION.md), and an @-description in app_en.arb for new keys. Remove keys a change leaves unused. Run `flutter gen-l10n`; never edit lib/l10n/generated/.
Snackbars go through `showFeedback` (App/lib/widgets/app_components.dart), as everywhere else.
Packages run one at a time in the order of this file: P101 to P106. Numbering continues after the 2026-10-13-app run (P1–P100) so the two runs can't be confused. P102 builds on P101's save path.

Owner decisions (.claude/ux-review/DECISIONS.md) hold. Speed is the bar: as little interaction as possible beyond speaking, capture clearly faster than typing, several captures in a row just as fast; no new settings; subtract first. The free tier is decided: 10 dictations a month, typing never capped; never touch the login wall or the limit. D3 (the capture direction), D9 (an undated task goes on a later selected day; P102 narrows 'selected' to a day the person picked) and D10 stand. Don't build this run's owner questions (UX-615 auto-save, UX-616 a faster assistant, UX-617 teaching several tasks at once), U13's two tabs or U14 option 2.

Pending packages of the 2026-10-13-app run touch nearby code but aren't part of this run: P30 (UX-424: start-up and session restore waiting on reminders), P41 (U12: the first-run line), P43 (U11: renames such as Sin fecha and Sin guardar). Don't do their work here.

Tests: implementers keep the existing tests passing and update the ones a change rightly breaks; they don't write the acceptance tests. ux-tester writes those from `acceptance`: 'Widget test' and 'Unit test' name the proof expected; 'Code', 'grep' and 'Render' lines are for the reviewer; `deviceChecks` need a phone. The fake speech classes in App/test/ override `NativeSpeech.capability()`.

Dates in the checks are written for today = Wednesday 14 Oct 2026: Thursday is 'Mañana', Friday 'vie, 16 oct', Saturday 'sáb, 17 oct' (the report's 'vie, 17 oct' and 'sáb, 18 oct' are a day off for 2026). `dayLabel` reads DateTime.now(), so tests may use days relative to the real today; the expected text is then that day's `weekdayDate` (MMMEd), or Hoy / Mañana.
No agent touches a phone or an emulator. Kotlin changes are checked in code and on a phone (`deviceChecks`); their Dart side is tested with fake events.

packages.title: Saving and Listo never wait on the network or on diagnostics
brief: Context: the capture-speed review of 2026-10-14 (.claude/ux-review/runs/2026-10-14-speed/review-A.md). The owner's bar: as little interaction as possible beyond speaking, capture clearly faster than typing, and several captures in a row just as fast (DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-13 late). This package removes waits the person can't see a reason for. No user-facing copy changes.

UX-601 (S3). `_CaptureResultState._save` (App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart, from :2039) writes the tasks to the phone in `_store.saveReady` (:2066-2070), then awaits `notifier.loadTasks()` (:2085) before the sheet closes (:2105-2111). `TaskNotifier._loadLoop` (App/lib/providers/task_provider.dart:39-60) awaits `_repository.sync()` (:47), which for a signed-in account is a full cloud sync (App/lib/repositories/cloud_task_repository.dart:102-245: lists, one PUT per unsent task, every page of tasks, then queued file uploads with a 45 s timeout each). Meanwhile 'Guardando…' shows, Back is blocked (`PopScope(canPop: !_saving)`, :2322-2323) and Cancelar is disabled; if a sync is already running, `loadTasks` waits for it and then runs another. Deshacer does the same at :2161. The typed path's `addTask` (task_provider.dart:63-67) already doesn't wait.

Fix UX-601 by subtracting the wait. Add one method to `TaskNotifier`, `showLocal()`: read `_repository.getAllTasks()`, set `state = AsyncValue.data(local)`, run `unawaited(TaskReminders.sync(local, ownerKey: _repository.ownerKey))`, then `unawaited(loadTasks())` so the cloud sync runs behind. It never awaits the network. In `_save`, replace `await notifier.loadTasks();` (:2085) with `await notifier.showLocal();`; in Deshacer, replace `await container.read(taskProvider.notifier).loadTasks();` (:2161) the same way. The rest of `_save` (closing, `calendarFocusProvider`, the message and its Deshacer) keeps its order.

A load that began before the save must never put back a list without the saved task (task_provider.dart:228 names the same race for `deleteTask`). For example, `showLocal` bumps a counter, and `_loadLoop` doesn't apply its first, pre-sync local read when the counter changed while that read ran; its read after `sync()` still applies, since it reads the database after the save. Don't change `addTask`, `updateTask`, `addTasks`, `deleteTask` or the `_mutate` methods.

Diagnostics never hold a tap (UX-601 and UX-610). `CaptureDiagnostics.record` already swallows its own errors (App/lib/services/capture_diagnostics.dart:66-77). In voice_task_screen.dart, every `await CaptureDiagnostics(...).record(...)` becomes `unawaited(...)`: :466, :568, :780, :1003 (between Listo and the request), :1514, :2030 (inside the edit chain `_save` awaits through `_writes`) and :2078 (before the sheet closes). In App/lib/services/capture_processor.dart `_process`, every `await diagnostics.record(...)` becomes `unawaited(...)`: :171, :185, :266, :288 and :305. Keep every `store.read`, `store.update` and `CaptureStore.recoverWav` awaited: they keep the capture safe.

UX-610 (S2, device check). After Listo, the native path waits up to 4 s for the recognizer's last words (`_stopRecording`, :988-994). Keep that cap; a phone measurement decides whether to shorten it. Make it measurable: add `recognizerFinish` at the end of the `CaptureEvent` enum (capture_diagnostics.dart) with the label 'Last words after Done'; in `_stopRecording`'s native path, time from just before `_speech.stop(_nativeRun)` until `_speechEnded` completes or its 4 s timeout fires, and record that, unawaited. Add a `recognizerFinish{…}` branch to `diagnosticsEvent` in the three ARB files: EN `Last words after Done` / ES `Últimas palabras tras Listo` / CA `Últimes paraules després de Fet`. The diagnostics screen shows only in debug builds and on staging (D13).

Don't touch: the 4 s cap, the AI request and its order, the landing and the save message (P102 changes them next), Guardar tal cual's rules, the typed editor. Tests that read diagnostics rows straight after an action may now need the write to finish first (a pump, or `tester.runAsync`): update those tests, not the behaviour.
acceptance: Widget test, Spanish: a signed-in account whose repository `sync()` never completes. From Calendar, save a spoken result for the coming Friday at 17:00 with 'Añadir al calendario'. The sheet closes without waiting for the sync; Calendar selects that Friday, its row is lit, and the message reads 'Añadida al vie, 16 oct' (that Friday's `weekdayDate`) with 'Deshacer'.
Widget test: with the same never-completing sync, tapping 'Deshacer' brings the result back in the sheet and the task leaves Calendar, without waiting for the sync.

Widget test: a sync already in progress when the save happens (a repository whose `sync()` completes only when the test says so): from the save on, the saved task is in `taskProvider`'s list and never leaves it, before and after that sync completes.
Widget test: after Listo on a native capture (fake recognizer), one `recognizerFinish` diagnostics row is recorded with an elapsed time.
Unit test: `diagnosticsEvent('recognizerFinish')` reads 'Last words after Done' / 'Últimas palabras tras Listo' / 'Últimes paraules després de Fet'.
Code: no `await` precedes `CaptureDiagnostics(...).record(` in voice_task_screen.dart, nor `diagnostics.record(` in capture_processor.dart.
Code: `_save` and its Deshacer call `showLocal()`; no `await …loadTasks()` remains in `_CaptureResultState`.
deviceChecks: Phone, signed in, on weak mobile data, with a photo upload queued on another task: dictate and save. The sheet starts closing at once (no lingering 'Guardando…') and the row lands lit; the photo uploads later.

Phone, debug build, Android 13+ and Android 12: clear Ajustes › Otros ajustes › Diagnóstico de captura, make 10 dictations, then read p50 and p95 of 'Last words after Done', 'Request and retained drafts' and 'Online task extraction'. The gap between the last two is the phone plus the network. Screen-record at 60 fps from the Listo tap to the result: the phone should add no more than 0.5 s beyond the server. If 'Last words after Done' has a p50 over about 1 s, report it: the next run caps that wait at about 1.5 s and sends the words on screen (not built now).

packages.title: A landing shows the task without re-dating the next one; a batch shows every place
brief: Context: the capture-speed review of 2026-10-14. After P101, `_save` sets the list from the phone before the sheet closes; build on that. D9 (DECISIONS.md): a task said or typed without a date goes on the selected calendar day when that day isn't today. The reviewer reads 'selected' as the day the person chose, and this package keeps D9 for those days.

UX-602 (S3). Calendar passes `TaskActions(day: _selectedDay)` (App/lib/screens/calendar_screen.dart:756). A landing (`_land`, :114-124) calls `_select(day)` to show the saved task, so the next capture opens with that day: `_ensureSession` keeps a later day on the session (App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart:536-570), and an undated result takes it (App/lib/services/capture_processor.dart:126-129, :243-248; App/lib/services/local_capture.dart:72). So after 'médico el viernes' lands on Friday, 'comprar pan' reads 'vie, 16 oct', and so does every later dictation or typed task until the person taps another day. A fast user saves the bread on Friday; a careful one spends three taps fixing it.

Fix: Calendar passes a day to capture only when the person picked it. Add `bool _picked = false`. Set it to true where the person picks a day: `onDaySelected` (:501-502, the week strip and the month view) and the 'Hoy' button (:452-456). In `_land`, when the landing selects a different day than `_selectedDay`, set `_picked = false`; a landing on the day already selected leaves it as it is. `_followToday` (:97-101) leaves it as it is (today adds no day anyway). Pass `TaskActions(day: _picked ? _selectedDay : null)` and update the comment at :755. The week strip still shows the landing's day selected; nothing visible changes.
Keep D9 for picked days. Don't touch the timeline (day_timeline_screen.dart passes its own day), Tareas, project pages, `_ensureSession`, `CaptureProcessor._laterDay` or `localDrafts`.

U5 (S2; reopened for one case). `_save` focuses Calendar on the earliest dated day (voice_task_screen.dart:2112-2132), and Calendar lights the no-date row only when no saved task has a date (calendar_screen.dart:114-124, :316-321). 'Recoger el coche el sábado por la mañana y pagar la luz' lands on Saturday with the car lit, while the undated bill sits unlit in the no-date row at the foot of the page, and the message says only '2 tareas añadidas'. A task saved on another day is out of sight and unnamed.

Fix U5, part 1. Add `final bool undated` (default false) to `CalendarFocus` (App/lib/providers/calendar_focus_provider.dart); `_save` sets it when any saved task (not a note) has no `dueDate`. In `_land`, light the no-date row too when `focus.undated`. When a dated row lands as well: the no-date row lights in the same frame as the dated row (not earlier, even if older undated tasks already make that row visible), with the same `_highlight` and the same fade; `_reveal()` runs once and targets the dated row; and the `_landedRow` GlobalKey goes only on the dated row (today :702 and :722 would both take it, which throws). An all-undated save works exactly as today, including UX-475's room under the row.

Fix U5, part 2. When the saved tasks' dates fall on more than one day and nothing stays pending (`remaining == 0`, the sheet closes), add the other days to the message after the count, with ' · ' as today: exactly one other day → `captureAlsoOn(date)` with `context.weekdayDate(day)`; two or more → `captureAlsoOnDays(count)`. 'Other days' are the distinct dated days other than the landing day (the earliest); undated tasks and notes add nothing. A save that leaves cards pending keeps today's message. New keys: `captureAlsoOn` EN `also on {date}` / ES `también el {date}` / CA `també el {date}`; `captureAlsoOnDays` EN `{count, plural, one{also on 1 other day} other{also on {count} other days}}` / ES `{count, plural, one{también en otro día} other{también en otros {count} días}}` / CA `{count, plural, one{també en un altre dia} other{també en {count} dies més}}`. The report wrote ES 'también otros {n} días'; 'también en otros {n} días' is the natural Spanish. The Catalan is the organizer's; plan.md asks for a native read.

How this fits UX_REVIEW §3.3, which sketched '3 tasks added · View': the message's one action stays Deshacer, so naming the days replaces a 'Ver' link and adds no control. Don't change `taskSavedInbox` or the no-date row's name (U11, P43 in the 2026-10-13-app run).
acceptance: Widget test, Spanish, Calendar on today: save a result for the coming Friday; it lands on Friday, selected in the week strip. Then 'Añadir tarea' and a result with no date ('comprar pan'): its date line reads 'Sin fecha'. The same holds when the second task is typed without Pro.
Widget test (D9 kept): then tap that Friday in the week strip, 'Añadir tarea', and a result with no date: its date line reads Friday's `weekdayDate` (e.g. 'vie, 16 oct').
Widget test: pick a later day in the week strip (not today or tomorrow), save a result dated another day (it lands there), then a result with no date reads 'Sin fecha'.
Widget test: in the month view, tap a later day; a result with no date takes that day.
Widget test (U5): one save with a Saturday task and an undated task lands on Saturday: the Saturday row and the no-date row are both lit in the same frame, both fade, and no exception is thrown.

Widget test (U5): a Friday task and a Saturday task in one save: the message reads '2 tareas añadidas · también el sáb, 17 oct' (Saturday's `weekdayDate`); Friday, Saturday and the next Monday: '3 tareas añadidas · también en otros 2 días'.
Widget test: an all-undated save still lands on the no-date row, lit, with 'Tarea guardada en la bandeja de entrada'; a single dated save still reads 'Añadida al …'.
Unit test: `captureAlsoOn('X')` is 'also on X' / 'también el X' / 'també el X'; `captureAlsoOnDays(2)` is 'also on 2 other days' / 'también en otros 2 días' / 'també en 2 dies més'.
deviceChecks: Phone, Spanish: UX_REVIEW §7 task 3, 'Recoger el coche el sábado por la mañana y pagar la luz'. Calendar shows Saturday with the car lit and the no-date row lit.
Phone: three dictations in a row from Calendar on today: 'médico el viernes a las 5 de la tarde', 'comprar pan', 'llamar a Juan'. The second and third results read 'Sin fecha'.

packages.title: Capture opens ready: the microphone first, and typing without a spinner
brief: Context: the capture-speed review of 2026-10-14. Tapping Añadir tarea must reach listening as fast as the phone allows. 'Volver a decirlo' already skips the set-up below and listens at once (App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart:1290), which shows those waits aren't needed. No copy changes. P101 already made the diagnostics writes unawaited.

UX-603 (S3). Before auto-start, `_load` (voice_task_screen.dart:435-514) awaits, on every open: the speech capability probe (:446; Kotlin builds and destroys a recognizer and waits up to 2.5 s, NativeSpeechBridge.kt:122-143; Dart waits up to 4 s, App/lib/services/native_speech.dart:53-57); the time-zone lookup (:449-454; it reads the phone's zone with a 5 s timeout, App/lib/providers/regional_provider.dart:202-218); and `cleanFinished` (:455), which decodes every saved capture ever kept (App/lib/services/capture_store.dart:401-410). Then one frame, the permission call and `_speech.start` (:516-533, :760-836). On Android 13+ the app's own microphone feed opens inside `start` and keeps words said before the recognizer is ready (NativeSpeechBridge.kt:211-228, :323-341), yet the sheet shows 'Un momento…' until the recognizer's `ready` (:253). Nothing said before `start` is kept, and Spanish often puts the date first ('Mañana llamar a Juan').

1. Remember the capability for the app session. In `NativeSpeech` (native_speech.dart) add `knownCapability(String language)`, which memoizes the Future per language (`nativeSpeechProvider` is one instance for the app), plus `remember(String language, SpeechCapability value)` and `forget(String language)`. The fake speech classes in App/test/ override `capability()`, so the memo lives outside it, in methods the fakes inherit. Don't keep an answer that came from `capability()`'s catch paths (an exception or the Dart timeout): the next open probes again. `_load` (:446) uses `knownCapability`. Forget the language after a failed native start (the catch at :900 when `_usingNative`, and an `error` event while the phase is still `starting`) and after `prepareLanguage` in Voz (App/lib/screens/voice_settings_screen.dart:67-75). Voz's `_check` (:43-52) keeps probing fresh and calls `remember` with the answer, so a visit to Voz refreshes it. A different speech language is a different key.

2. Warm it once, so the first capture of a session usually finds it ready (the organizer's addition; no UI). After the first frame of the first `TaskActions` (App/lib/widgets/task_actions.dart), when `voiceAvailableProvider` is true, start `knownCapability(<speech language>)` without awaiting it, at most once per language. Compute the language with the same `speechLanguageTag(...)` call `_load` makes (:441-445); move that call into one helper both use. It must not delay that screen's first frame.

3. Don't hold the microphone for the time zone. Start `CaptureTimezone.resolve(...)` at the top of `_load` as a stored Future and don't await it before auto-start. `_ensureSession` (:536-570) awaits it before `_store.create`, so every capture still stores the right zone. When it completes, set `_zone` and `_timezoneFallback` with setState, except for a resumed capture (`widget.captureId != null`), whose own zone (:462-464) wins.

4. Sweep after listening starts. Take `cleanFinished` (:455) out of `_load`. Run it at most once per app session per owner, unawaited and with errors swallowed, after listening has started or the typing field has focus. It's a sweep for leftovers: saved and discarded captures already drop their audio (capture_store.dart:250, :386).

5. 'Escuchando' as soon as words are kept, on Android 13+. In NativeSpeechBridge.kt `Attempt.begin()` (:211-228), right after `recognizer.startListening(request)` (:225) returns and when `feed != null`, emit a new event `listening` for the run (`emit(run, "listening")`). Add it to the `SpeechEvent` comment (native_speech.dart:23-25); it isn't terminal. In `_receiveSpeech` (:671-676), `listening` calls `_listening()` the way `ready` does (the status 'Escuchando · 00:00', the clock, the TalkBack announcement), but leaves `_nativePrefix` alone: only `ready` commits the field's words. Without a feed (Android 12 and below, or when the feed can't open) nothing changes.

UX-611 (S2, device check), the app's part. From the home-screen widget or a shortcut at a cold start, a free account at 0 left sees an unlabelled spinner until billing answers, which can need the network (`VoiceTaskScreen.build`, :245-252). Show that spinner only while billing loads and the free count is unknown (`freeVoiceLeftProvider` is null). When the saved account says 0 left, build `_VoiceCaptureScreen(voice: false, …)` at once, so typing opens with the keyboard. The open sheet keeps typing even if billing then reports Pro (`_voice` is latched at :305); the mic shows on the next capture.

UX-611's other causes belong to UX-424, planned as P30 in the 2026-10-13-app run and not yet run: start-up awaits the reminder setup (App/lib/main.dart:46-53), and `restore()` awaits `TaskReminders.activate` before the account is set (App/lib/providers/auth_provider.dart:74-81). Don't touch main.dart or auth_provider.dart here.

Don't touch: TalkBack's path (listening waits for 'Empezar a hablar'), the permission handling, the 60 s cap, segment restarts, the recorder (non-native) path beyond reading the remembered capability, the privacy line.
acceptance: Widget test: with a fake whose `capability()` takes 2 s, the first open calls `start` after it answers. Close the sheet and open it again: `start` is called without waiting, and `capability()` was called only once.
Widget test: after a failed native start (the fake throws from `start`), the next open calls `capability()` again.
Widget test: an answer from `capability()`'s error path (the call throws or times out) isn't remembered: the next open calls it again.
Widget test: after Voz's set-up (`prepareLanguage`), the next capture calls `capability()` again.
Widget test: Calendar with 'Añadir tarea' and the mic available calls `capability()` once by itself after its first frame; opening capture then calls `start` without a second call.
Widget test: with a time-zone lookup that takes 3 s, `start` is called before the lookup completes, and the capture created from the first words stores the zone the lookup returned.
Widget test: with a `cleanFinished` that takes 2 s, or throws, `start` is still called first and no error shows.

Widget test: a fake recognizer that emits `listening` and no `ready` shows 'Escuchando · 00:00' and announces `captureListening` once; a later `ready` keeps the words shown and doesn't restart the clock.

Widget test (UX-611): a free account with 0 dictations left while billing is still loading: opening capture from Calendar shows the typing field with focus and no CircularProgressIndicator. With the free count unknown, the spinner still shows until billing answers.
Widget test (UX-611): in that state, billing then reporting Pro leaves the open sheet in typing; the next capture opens listening.
deviceChecks: Phone, debug build, Android 13+ and Android 12: clear Ajustes › Otros ajustes › Diagnóstico de captura, open capture 10 times, then read 'Capture ready to use' p50 and p95. Screen-record at 60 fps and count frames from the tap on 'Añadir tarea' to 'Escuchando': 0.5 s or less, warm.
Phone, Android 13+: tap 'Añadir tarea' and at once say 'mañana comprar pan'. The task is dated tomorrow, and 'Ver lo que dije' starts with 'mañana'.

Phone: force-stop TaskFlow in the phone's app settings (never clear its data), then screen-record from a tap on the home-screen widget to 'Escuchando', 5 times cold and 5 times warm; repeat for the 'Dictar una tarea' shortcut, and for 'Escribir una tarea' up to the keyboard. Targets: 1 s or less warm, 3 s or less cold. The cold numbers also depend on P30 of the 2026-10-13-app run.
Phone, a free account at 0 left: a cold start from 'Escribir una tarea' brings up the keyboard with no spinner.

packages.title: Typed dates understand parts of the day and 'pasado mañana'
brief: Context: the capture-speed review of 2026-10-14. `QuickScheduleParser.parse` (App/lib/services/quick_schedule_parser.dart) reads dates on the phone for free typing (every task, for a free account after its 10 dictations) and for 'Guardar tal cual' when the assistant is slow or offline, through `localDrafts` (App/lib/services/local_capture.dart:96-119). 'Guardar tal cual' saves at once when nothing is asked (voice_task_screen.dart:1213, :1978-1985). No test covers the phrases below; each miss costs three taps to fix, or a wrong task saved with no review.

UX-604 (S3). Today, with today = Wed 14 Oct 2026: 'Llamar a mamá mañana por la mañana' and 'Médico el viernes por la mañana' get no date (two date words, :82-83); 'Llamar a Juan por la mañana' is dated tomorrow with the title 'Llamar a Juan por la' ('mañana' always means tomorrow, :49); 'Recoger el coche pasado mañana' is dated tomorrow with the title 'Recoger el coche pasado', and Catalan 'demà passat' fails the same way; 'Médico el viernes a las 5 de la tarde' asks '¿A qué hora?' and is titled 'Médico de la tarde' (a bare hour always asks, :64-65, :149-166). The speech hints (native_speech.dart:137-147) push the recognizer towards exactly these phrases.

Rule 1. 'mañana' right after 'la' (so 'por la', 'de la', 'en la', 'a la'), 'esta' or 'cada' is the morning, not a date word. Catalan ('demà' / 'matí') and English ('tomorrow' / 'morning') already use different words.

Rule 2. 'pasado mañana', 'demà passat', 'passat demà' and '(the) day after tomorrow' are one date phrase: two days after the reference day. Put them before the single words in the date alternation, so the whole phrase matches and leaves the title. ('passat demà', the same Catalan phrase in the other order, is the organizer's addition.)

Rule 3. A part of the day next to an hour written without a. m./p. m. settles the period, and its words leave the title, whether it comes before the hour ('por la tarde a las 5', 'al matí a les 9', 'morning at 9') or after it ('a las 5 de la tarde', 'a les 9 del matí', 'at 9 in the morning', 'at 8 tonight'). Morning: mañana, matí, morning → a. m. Afternoon: tarde, tarda, afternoon → p. m. Evening and night: noche, nit, vespre, evening, night, tonight → p. m. for hours 5 to 11 only. Hour 12 with any part of the day, and hours 1 to 4 with a night word, keep today's question: they can mean either. Linking words to accept: ES 'por la', 'de la', 'en la', 'esta'; CA 'al', 'del', 'a la', 'de la', 'aquest', 'aquesta'; EN 'in the', 'this', 'at' (as in 'at night'). The same applies to an H:MM time from 1:00 to 11:59 written without a. m./p. m.: 'a las 5:30 de la tarde' today saves 05:30 and keeps 'de la tarde' in the title (the organizer's extension of the same rule).

Rule 4. A part of the day with no hour, or one that settles nothing, stays in the title and sets no time: 'Llamar a mamá mañana por la mañana' is tomorrow, with no time, titled 'Llamar a mamá por la mañana'.

Keep: deadline markers, a single explicit date, 'a las 17' → 17:00, a bare 'a las 5' with no part of the day still asking, the 'or / actually / mejor / o' bail-out, quoted titles. Don't touch local_capture.dart (it capitalizes the title), the speech hints, the date sheet or the server.
acceptance: Unit test (reference Wed 14 Oct 2026, 10:00): 'Llamar a mamá mañana por la mañana' → Thu 15 Oct, no time, title 'Llamar a mamá por la mañana'.
Unit test: 'Médico el viernes por la mañana' → Fri 16 Oct, no time, title 'Médico por la mañana'.

packages.title: The result card: notes only when there are some, a title that looks editable, one-tap day fixes
brief: Context: the capture-speed review of 2026-10-14. The result card (App/lib/widgets/capture_review_editor.dart) is where a person checks and corrects a task before saving. Correcting by touch should beat saying it again, which for a free account costs one of the month's dictations. Order of severity inside: UX-606, UX-607, UX-608 (S2), UX-613 (S1).

UX-606 (S2). The notes field (:452-470, `minLines: 2`) shows on every open card, between the date and Más opciones: about 70 dp at 1×, double at 2×, although short dictations have no notes. Show the field only when the task has notes, when it's a note (`task.isNote`: the field is its body), or after the person opened it. When it's hidden, the first row inside Más opciones (`if (_options) ...[`, :539) is 'Añadir notas', using the existing `addNotes` key (EN `Add notes` / ES `Añadir notas` / CA `Afegeix notes`) and `Icons.notes_rounded`. Tapping it shows the field in its usual place (under the date line) with focus and the keyboard up; it stays shown for that card even if emptied again. The field keeps `hintText: l.addNotes`. Single results and opened batch cards behave the same. Tap targets on a single spoken result go from 8 to 7.

UX-607 (S2). The title (:420-443) and notes fields use `border: InputBorder.none` (:435-436, :464-465), so the title reads as a heading and nothing says it can be tapped and corrected; the date line has a chevron, the title nothing. Give both fields an underline: `enabledBorder: UnderlineInputBorder(borderSide: BorderSide(color: colors.outline))` (UX-412's colour: 3.79:1 light, 4.85:1 dark), `focusedBorder: UnderlineInputBorder(borderSide: BorderSide(color: colors.primary, width: 2))`, and `border` and `disabledBorder` in `colors.outlineVariant` for the saving state. The theme's default is an outlined box (App/lib/theme/app_theme.dart:85-93); an underline keeps the title's heading look. Keep the labels, the text style, `filled: false` and the content padding. No new control.

UX-608 (S2). On the result, the date sheet's Hoy, Mañana and Sin fecha chips only select (App/lib/widgets/schedule_editor.dart:229-247; they apply at once only when `moving != null`, :242), so fixing a day takes the date line, a chip and Listo before the save, while moving a saved task already applies them at once (UX-206, UX-453). Add `bool applyDays = false` to `editSchedule` and `_ScheduleEditor`; the chips call `_done()` when `moving != null || widget.applyDays`. `_CaptureReviewEditorState._schedule` (:77-120) passes `applyDays: true`, for the date line and for the deadline row, so the result behaves one way. `_done` already keeps the time for Hoy and Mañana and drops it for Sin fecha. A day picked in the calendar, or a time, still ends with Listo. The edit form (TaskEditor) keeps select-only; update the doc comment on `editSchedule` (:16-17) and the comment at :238-240.

UX-613 (S1). An opened batch card shows its title twice: in its header (:393-417, a TextButton) and in the title field (:420-443). When `widget.compact && widget.expanded`, the header keeps only ✕ (aligned to the end, same tooltip); the title lives in the field. Collapsed cards keep the title button and ✕. Opening another card still closes this one.

Previews: in App/test/review_tasks_test.dart's WRITE_REVIEW_PREVIEWS set, add a direct result without notes (light and dark) and an opened batch card (light), next to the existing review-direct and review-batch renders.
Don't touch: the date line's look and semantics (UX-458, UX-462), the questions, the assignment picker, the checklist editor, the repair row, `reviewRemove` (P106 changes its text), TaskEditor.
acceptance: Widget test (UX-606), Spanish: a direct spoken result 'Comprar pan' without notes shows no notes field (`draft-notes`) and no 'Notas' label; after tapping 'Más opciones', 'Añadir notas' is its first row; tapping it shows the notes field with focus. A result with notes shows the field as before, and 'Más opciones' has no 'Añadir notas'.
Widget test (UX-606): a note capture always shows its body field.
Widget test (UX-606): after 'Añadir notas', typing in the field and clearing it again leaves the field shown.
Widget test (UX-607): the title field's `enabledBorder` is an `UnderlineInputBorder` in `colorScheme.outline`, in light and dark; so is the notes field's when it shows.
Render (UX-607): review-direct, light and dark, shows a line under the title; the new review-direct render without notes shows no notes field.

Widget test (UX-608), Spanish: a result dated the coming Friday at 17:00; tap the date line, then 'Mañana': the sheet closes and the line reads 'Mañana · 17:00'. 'Sin fecha' closes it and the line reads 'Sin fecha'. Picking a day in the calendar doesn't close the sheet; 'Listo' does.
Widget test (UX-608): in TaskEditor, the date sheet's 'Mañana' still only selects; the sheet stays open.
Widget test (UX-613): open one card of a two-task batch: its title text appears exactly once (in the field), and its ✕ is still there with its tooltip.
deviceChecks: Phone, UX_REVIEW §7 style, with someone new to the app: the result heard 'Comprar pon'; ask them to make it 'pan'. They tap the title rather than 'Volver a decirlo' (inferred from the render; needs people).

packages.title: Leaving a result asks first; fewer words at 0 left; no 'borrador'
brief: Context: the capture-speed review of 2026-10-14. U2's approved rule (UX_REVIEW §6, D3): Cancel asks keep or discard. The free tier (DECISIONS.md): 10 dictations a month, typing never capped, and the app shows what's left; don't change when its lines show or what counts.

UX-605 (S2). On a result, Cancelar (`_exits`, App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart:2252-2259, `Navigator.maybePop`), Back and a tap on the dimmed area close the sheet with no question, and the result silently stays pending; 'Capturas pendientes · 1' then sits on top of Añadir tarea (App/lib/widgets/task_actions.dart:28-46). While listening, the same Cancelar asks (`_cancel`, :1347-1398). Discarding a single result takes four hidden taps today. This reverses part of UX-457 (b3: 'Cancelar closes with no dialog') on purpose, to follow U2.

Fix: in `_CaptureResultState.build`, replace `PopScope(canPop: !_saving)` (:2322-2323) with `PopScope(canPop: false, onPopInvokedWithResult: …)`, so Cancelar, Back, the scrim and a swipe (all go through `maybePop`: `_CaptureSheetRoute`, `_SheetFrame`) reach one handler. Like listening's (:1738-1742), it acts only when `didPop` is false: a save's `Navigator.pop` also calls it, with `didPop` true. While saving, it does nothing. With no card left pending (all removed), it closes at once as 'Terminar' does (`_finishEmpty`, which discards). Otherwise it shows the same AlertDialog as listening: title `captureKeepQuestion`, no content, a red TextButton `discard` and a FilledButton `keep`; build that dialog in one helper both states use. 'Descartar' discards as listening's `_discard` does (:1454-1470): await `_writes`, `_store.discard(_session.id, _session.ownerKey)`, record `CaptureEvent.discarded` unawaited, set `_finished = true`, invalidate `pendingCapturesProvider`, close; on failure show `captureDiscardFailed` in the sheet. 'Conservar' closes and keeps it pending, as today. Dismissing the dialog stays on the result. Saving still closes with `Navigator.pop` / `popUntil`, which PopScope doesn't block.

One wording for the question, while listening, typing and on the result. `captureKeepQuestion`: EN `Keep it for later?` / ES `¿Quieres conservarlo para más tarde?` / CA `Ho vols conservar per a més tard?`. The buttons stay `discard` (`Discard` / `Descartar` / `Descarta`) and `keep` (`Keep` / `Conservar` / `Conserva`). Remove `captureKeepHelp` from the dialog and from the three ARB files, and update the description of `captureKeepQuestion`. After 'Volver a decirlo', Cancelar while listening still goes back to the result without asking (`_backToResult`); the recording-only state at 0 left keeps its single 'Cerrar' (UX-502).

UX-614 (S1). 'Volver a decirlo' shows on every spoken result (`_exits`, :2252-2280), and with no Pro and no free dictation left it opens typing (:1268). Show it only while `ref.watch(voiceAvailableProvider)` is true; otherwise Cancelar stands alone at the start, as on typed results. Cancelar and the touch corrections stay.

UX-609 (S2). At 0 left, every typed task starts under a 17-word line (`freeVoiceUsedUp`, shown at :1561-1567 and :1691-1711, and in Capturas pendientes through `freeVoiceUsedUpText`, App/lib/screens/captures_screen.dart:36). Its 'escribirla' / 'type it' has nothing to refer to, and the field already has focus. New `freeVoiceUsedUp`: EN `No free dictations until {date}.` / ES `Sin dictados gratis hasta el {date}.` / CA `Fins al dia {date} no tens dictats gratuïts.` (the date stays mid-sentence in Catalan, as UX-503 settled). Keep 'Ver Pro', the live region and the key `free-voice-used-up`. `freeVoiceUsedUpRecording`, `freeVoiceLeft` and `freeVoiceStatus` don't change.

UX-612 (S2). Capture copy names the user's tasks 'borrador' / 'esborrany' / 'draft', while the header says 'cosas' and the button 'tareas'. Exact copy, EN / ES / CA: `reviewRemoved` `Removed` / `Quitada` / `Treta`; `reviewUndoSaved` `They’re back here, not saved yet.` / `Han vuelto aquí, sin guardar.` / `Tornen a ser aquí, sense desar.`; `captureRemovedDraftsHelp` `Nothing will be added.` / `No se añadirá nada.` / `No s’afegirà res.`; `capturesEmptyHelp` `Recordings and tasks you leave unfinished are kept here.` / `Aquí se guardan las grabaciones y las tareas que dejes a medias.` / `Aquí es guarden les gravacions i les tasques que deixis a mig fer.`; `captureWriteFailed` `Couldn’t keep this on your phone. Try again before leaving.` / `No se ha podido guardar en el teléfono. Inténtalo de nuevo antes de salir.` / `No s’ha pogut conservar al telèfon. Torna-ho a provar abans de sortir.`; `reviewRemove` `Remove` / `Quitar` / `Treu`.

`captureDraftSummary` drops its `ready` count (and Spanish 'listos'): EN `{count, plural, one{1 not added yet} other{{count} not added yet}}` / ES `{count, plural, one{1 sin añadir} other{{count} sin añadir}}` / CA `{count, plural, one{1 sense afegir} other{{count} sense afegir}}`; update the call at App/lib/screens/captures_screen.dart:28-29 to pass only the count. Remove the unused `captureReviewRetainedHelp`, which still says 'borradores'. Leave the debug-only diagnostics strings (`diagnosticsEvent`, `diagnosticsMeasurementHelp`).

Don't touch: `captureThingsToAdd`, `captureNothingToReview`, the ✕ tooltip `removeCaptureItem`, the names 'Capturas pendientes' and 'bandeja' (U11, P43 in the 2026-10-13-app run), Ver Pro, the pending list's layout.
acceptance: Widget test (UX-605), Spanish: on a spoken result, 'Cancelar' shows '¿Quieres conservarlo para más tarde?' with 'Descartar' and 'Conservar', and no second line. 'Descartar' closes the sheet and nothing is left in Capturas pendientes; 'Conservar' closes it and one capture is pending.
Widget test (UX-605): on a result, the system Back and a tap on the dimmed area above the sheet show the same question; dismissing the dialog leaves the result open.
Widget test (UX-605): while typing, 'Cancelar' with words asks '¿Quieres conservarlo para más tarde?'; while listening with words, the same.
Widget test (UX-605): after 'Volver a decirlo', 'Cancelar' while listening returns to the result with no dialog.
Widget test (UX-605): with every batch card removed, Back closes the sheet with no dialog and nothing is pending.
Widget test (UX-605): 'Añadir al calendario' still closes the sheet and lands, with no dialog.
Widget test (UX-614): a free account's result at 0 left (it shows 'Ya no te quedan dictados gratis este mes') has no 'Volver a decirlo'; with dictations left, or with Pro, it has.

Widget test (UX-609): a free account at 0 left, free dictations back on 1 November, at 2× text on 320 dp: the typing sheet's line reads 'Sin dictados gratis hasta el 1 nov.' (ES), 'Fins al dia 1 de nov. no tens dictats gratuïts.' (CA) and 'No free dictations until Nov 1.' (EN); it takes at most two lines, contains no '..', and the typing field stays visible above a 300 dp keyboard inset.

Unit test (UX-612): outside `diagnosticsEvent` and `diagnosticsMeasurementHelp`, no value in app_en.arb, app_es.arb or app_ca.arb contains 'draft', 'borrador' or 'esborrany' (case-insensitive); `captureKeepHelp` and `captureReviewRetainedHelp` are gone from all three.
Widget test (UX-612): removing a batch card shows 'Quitada' with 'Deshacer'; Capturas pendientes lists a capture with three cards left as 'Tareas · 3 sin añadir'.
deviceChecks: Phone, Android 13+ with gesture navigation: a back swipe on a result shows '¿Quieres conservarlo para más tarde?' instead of closing the sheet; with TalkBack, the question and both buttons are read.

decisions.question: UX-615: Should a spoken result with nothing to ask save itself, with Deshacer, instead of waiting for 'Añadir al calendario'?
decisions.recommendation: Not now. It would cut a capture to 2 taps (Añadir tarea, Listo) and about 1–2 s, but it changes D3/U4's confirming tap, and a misheard date would be saved without a look; the safety net would be the landing, Deshacer and the date in the message. Keep the tap until the §7 test with your father, then decide (the reviewer's recommendation).

decisions.question: UX-616: Should the assistant's wait be cut on the server, with a faster model or by understanding while the person is still speaking?
decisions.recommendation: Measure first. Staging took 1.3, 4.8, 4.8, 4.8 and once 20.5 s: the longest wait in capture now, and only server work can cut it, at a cost. P101 adds the phone's own share to Diagnóstico de captura, and its device check splits phone, network and server. If the server is still most of the wait, try a faster model for task extraction on staging and compare cost and accuracy; understanding while speaking is a much larger change.

decisions.question: UX-617: Should the app teach that one dictation can hold several tasks? One dictation gives three tasks in 3 taps; three dictations take 9.
decisions.recommendation: Not in the first-run line yet. P41 (U12, in the 2026-10-13-app run, not yet built) keeps one task, as UX_REVIEW §5.6 has it: a newcomer's first try should be one thing. §7 task 3 shows whether your father says two things in one go when asked; decide after that test.
